control.correspondence: matched_control_group is carried verbatim from the integer corpus
control.rule: control = arithmetic mean over matched_control_group vehicle rows, each normalized on its own selected-axis library total

normalization.denominator: selected gene axis G_5000, before CP10K and natural log1p
normalization.library_total: sum of the profile's selected G_5000 integer counts (int64)

view_generation.recipe: Stream bounded integer corpus batches; select G_5000 in ascending original gene_index; sum selected counts in int64; normalize every row independently with natural log1p(CP10K); average normalized matched vehicles for control; delta = X - control. Publish float32.
